title: A Godly Man Can Want a Wife and Not Need One
caption:
Wanting a wife isn't the problem. Needing her to be your god is.

A man chasing God first isn't waiting around empty. He's being built into someone worth choosing, one faithful day at a time. The order matters: seek Him first, and let everything else, including her, come after.

Tag a brother who needs to hear this today.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #singleness #discipleship
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
